name: OpenID Connect
description:
This plugin allows users to sign in through an OIDC provider (such as Google, Facebook, or your own provider). This enables one-click signin.
Review documentation at https://github.com/DaniCatGames/jellyfin-openid-connect
overview: Authenticate users against an OIDC provider.

versions.changelog:
- Rename plugin to OpenID Connect
- Update to Jellyfin 12/.NET 10
- Allow toggling user provisioning per provider
- Added new config UI
- Add way to test provider from config panel
- Restrict auto-linking to selected users to prevent accidental/malicious account takeover, IdP users with names matching an existing jellyfin account get new accounts with the name of the IdP or user sub as a suffix
- Use picture claim (configurable) for user profile pictures
- Use sub claim instead of preferred_username (or configured) for linking IdP users to jellyfin users, so changing IdP name wont result in a new jellyfin account being created.
- Select default authentication provider (for jellyfin, not IdP) with a dropdown instead of text field
- Always allow users with admin roles to log in
- Removed deprecated flow paths (/r/, /p/)
- Removed references to SAML
- Use ConcurrentDictionary for safety
- Fixed a bunch of null safety issues
- Fix linking
- Correctly remove links when unregistering
- Delete links pointing to a user when that user is deleted by an admin
- Bunch of small fixes
- Update API paths
- Ensure provider names are safe to use in URLs
- Clarified a bunch of config options
- Validate endpoint, client id, and secret exist when creating provider
- Log IP addresses correctly into the authentication logs
- Scopes configuration option is much improved
- Restrict flows to browser by adding a cookie to each login flow
- Add SSRF protection to user avatar retrieval
